dialogs.about: 사촌의 결혼식 카드를 보며 할아버지와 이야기

lines.en: Good morning. A card came. Who is getting married?
lines.ko: 좋은 아침이에요. 카드가 왔어요. 누가 결혼해요?

lines.en: It's a wedding card from my cousin.
Oh, when is the ceremony?
They will marry next Sunday at noon.
Did they invite us to the dinner too?
Yes, they invited us last week by phone.
I'm glad. The bride is a kind young woman.
Do you know the groom well?
Yes, he is a teacher. They are a nice couple.
lines.ko: 네, 선생님이에요. 두 사람은 좋은 짝이에요.

lines.en: Let's buy a bouquet and congratulate them.
Excuse me. Where is the wedding hall?
It's on the second floor. Please use the elevator.
Thank you. Did the ceremony start already?
No, it starts soon. The bride is getting ready.
lines.ko: 아니요, 곧 시작해요. 신부가 준비하고 있어요.

lines.en: Where can I put this bouquet?
Give it to the bride after the ceremony, please.
I met the groom here last spring.
He is very kind. Everyone likes that young couple.
lines.ko: 아주 친절한 분이에요. 모두 그 젊은 부부를 좋아해요.

lines.en: I will congratulate them after the ceremony.
lines.ko: 예식이 끝나면 축하 인사를 할 거예요.

lines.en: Please come in now. The seats are ready.
